recipe.name: Double Pumpkin Muffins

dry.note: Measure before blending. Blend all for smooth muffins, or blend half and leave half whole for texture. See oatSwap below for the higher-protein version.

wet.note: Add 1 tbsp at a time only if batter is too thick

oatSwap.wholeFoodVersion: Use 3 1/2 cups rolled oats total. No protein powder.
oatSwap.proteinVersion: Use 2 cups rolled oats + 4 scoops vanilla protein powder (add the powder with the dry ingredients). Same wet ingredients and fold-ins.
oatSwap.rule: Oat flour = blended oats. No separate oat flour needed.

steps: Heat oven to 350F. Grease or line 24 muffin cups.
In one large bowl, stir together all dry ingredients. Make a well in the center.
Add all wet ingredients to the well.
Mix until just combined; do not overmix.
If batter is too thick, add milk 1 tbsp at a time, up to 1/2 cup.
Scoop batter into the 24 muffin cups.
Bake 18-22 minutes, starting to check at 18 minutes. Done when a toothpick comes out clean-ish.
Cool 5-10 minutes before removing from the pan.

macrosPerMuffin.notes: Estimates. With optional syrup included. Vary by brand.

recipe.storage: Fridge up to 4 days; freeze 2-3 months.
